build.note.value: Example values from tracked files. A host makes its own build from a value file under .local/architecture/.

client.server_url.value: url in ovcli.conf; the example is http://localhost:1933

ingress.value.value: Not part of compose.yaml. The example override joins the external network ingress.

runtime.state.value: ./data on the host, /app/.openviking in the container; workspace /app/.openviking/data

runtime.engine_value.value: Compose project openviking, service openviking, restart unless-stopped, health check every 30 s

runtime.server_value.value: Listens on 0.0.0.0:1933 in the container (OPENVIKING_SERVER_HOST, OPENVIKING_SERVER_PORT)

env.value.value: Keys of .env.example: OPENVIKING_ROOT_API_KEY (no default), OPENVIKING_IMAGE, OPENVIKING_PUBLIC_BASE_URL, OPENVIKING_BIND, OPENVIKING_PORT

conf.value.value: examples/ov.conf.quickstart: sections server, storage, embedding and vlm, with placeholder model endpoints

conf.auth_mode.value: api_key, because a root key is set

embedding.value.value: provider openai, api_base http://127.0.0.1:9/v1, model placeholder-embedding, dimension 1024

vlm.value.value: provider openai, api_base http://127.0.0.1:9/v1, model placeholder-vlm

rerank.value.value: examples/ov.conf.quickstart has no rerank section, so search uses the vector scores

bot.value.value: examples/ov.conf.quickstart has no bot section, so VikingBot uses the vlm settings

vectordb.value.value: storage.vectordb.backend local (code default), dimension 1024 from the embedding

repo.origin.value: the private server that the clone comes from

repo.shared.value: the URL in SHARED_URL, for example a GitHub repository

base.rust.value: RUST_IMAGE and RUST_DIGEST in docker-bake.hcl and the Dockerfile

base.node.value: NODE_IMAGE and NODE_DIGEST in docker-bake.hcl and the Dockerfile

base.python.value: PYTHON_IMAGE and PYTHON_DIGEST in docker-bake.hcl and the Dockerfile

image.labels.value: source SOURCE_URL (upstream by default), version <upstream>-p<portable>, licenses AGPL-3.0

override.value.value: container_name openviking, external network ingress, OPENVIKING_PUBLIC_BASE_URL https://openviking.example.com
